title.rendered: Delta State Athletics Schedule Includes Football, Basketball and Tennis

content.rendered:
Delta State’s athletic teams have several events scheduled from Monday through Sunday, including football at Frostburg State, a women’s basketball exhibition at Arkansas State and tennis at the Gulf South Conference Fall Tournament in Tuscaloosa, Alabama.

The women’s basketball team is scheduled to play at Arkansas State at 7 p.m. Wednesday in Jonesboro, Arkansas. Delta State football is set to face Frostburg State at 11 a.m. Saturday at Bobcat Stadium in Frostburg, Maryland. The tennis tournament runs Friday through Sunday.

Delta State softball is scheduled to play a doubleheader against Northwest Community College on Saturday in Cleveland, Mississippi. The women’s soccer game against Valdosta State, listed for Sunday, has no confirmed time or location.

The schedule also lists a Mississippi Farm Bureau press conference at 11 a.m. Monday in the Arant Family Room at Chadwick Dickson. The event will be streamed on Delta State’s YouTube channel, and media members are invited to attend.

Delta State highlighted football players Qualon Farrar and Jordan Bradley as players of the week. The school said Farrar had 87 yards and two touchdowns in the Statesmen’s win. Bradley scored on a fumble recovery and recorded three tackles and a pass breakup.

Source: Original Article
